name: Inverted Row
steps: Lie beneath a waist-high bar and grasp it overhand just outside shoulder width.
Extend your legs, plant your heels and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Draw your elbows behind your ribs until your chest approaches the underside of the bar.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower your body slowly back to full arm extension.
tips: Keep your hips lifted in line with your torso rather than letting them sag toward the floor.
Pull with your back and keep your neck neutral instead of craning your chin toward the bar.
